part.text:
Implemented support for Node.js 18+ spec-compliant `FormData` and `Blob` payloads in the HTTP adapter.

- Added multipart serialization helpers: `lib/helpers/formDataToStream.js`, `lib/helpers/readBlob.js`
- Added `utils.isSpecCompliantForm`
- Updated `lib/adapters/http.js` to stream spec-compliant FormData/Blob bodies with correct headers
- Added `formdata-node` test dependency metadata

Validation: targeted FormData/Blob tests pass (`5 passing`), ESLint passes. Full unit suite reached `140 passing`; the 2 failures are pre-existing environment/timing issues (HTTPS certificate timeout and a flaky port-based max-content-length test).
